name: MIP map filtering for multiple scattering
aliases: Elek et al. [2013] MIP map filtering
definition: A method to efficiently apply Gaussian blurring for multiple-scattering light transport by using MIP maps to reduce the computational cost of neighborhood filtering compared to naive gathering.
summary: MIP map filtering approximates multiple scattering by applying Gaussian blurring via hierarchical MIP maps, reducing computational complexity from O(n^4) to O(n^2 log n) for real-time GPU rendering.
